question: What has been declared and what will be explained next in due order?
premises: The method of enunciation has been declared for the sake of an easy summary.
Now the examination of the definition of this subject will begin.
The topics will be explained in due order.
inference: Having completed the summary of topics, the text will now proceed to define and examine them in order.
plain_english: Thus the method of enunciation has been declared for the sake of an easy summary. Now, in the examination of its definition, the topics are explained in due order.
